title: Configuration code decoding
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be a configuration whose work-tape heads lie within distance $s$ of the origin and whose work tapes are blank outside that window. Decoding the code of $C$ at window size $s$ returns some configuration $D$ that also lies within the window, has the same code as $C$, and has the same state, input-head position, work-tape contents and head positions, and output summary as $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine N
Every work-tape head position of C has absolute value at most s
Every work-tape cell of C strictly outside the window has no symbol
